data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year reserve release of $40.8m in 2016. This release reflects favourable claims development and the release of reserving margins originally held for uncertainty. The releases were distributed across divisions (notably Specialty lines and Property), resulting in an overall improvement to prior years' reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Beazley has a consistent reserving philosophy, with initial reserves being set to include risk margins that may be released over time as and when any uncertainty reduces.
During 2016, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $40.8m (2015: $40.3m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount ($40.8m) was taken from narrative text ('During 2016, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $40.8m...'). The report does not present a single labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' with a gross insurance liabilities column; therefore the narrative figure was used. It is possible the narrative figure could represent net or gross; the note and divisional table suggest gross releases but this cannot be 100% verified against a dedicated gross prior-year movement line. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Mapping of 'Political risks and contingency' and 'Reinsurance' divisions to standard Lloyd's LOBs in lob_movements required best-fit choices and carries some uncertainty.

_claims_triangle.notes: The technical provisions note contains gross ultimate claims development percentage tables and a per-underwriting-year current gross claims liabilities row (Beazley managed level and 623 share). A full numeric development-by-period triangle (cumulative amounts at each development lag) suitable for diagonal comparison was not provided in explicit numeric rows for all development periods; only percentage development tables and final per-year gross liabilities are present. Because of this, detailed development period rows were not constructed.
